mapper.select: WITH active_student AS ( SELECT student.student_id FROM biz_student student INNER JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id WHERE user.dept_id = #{deptId} AND user.del_flag = '0' AND user.status = '0' AND student.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND student.class_code = #{classCode} ), first_answer AS ( SELECT answer.student_id, MIN(answer.submit_time) AS first_answer_time FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN active_student active ON active.student_id = answer.student_id WHERE answer.lesson_id = #{lessonId} GROUP BY answer.student_id ), ranked_answer AS ( SELECT first_answer_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_answer_time, student_id) AS answer_rank FROM first_answer ) SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM biz_lesson_question lesson_question INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = lesson_question.question_id WHERE lesson_question.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND question.question_type = 'practical' ) AS hasPractical, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_student) AS totalStudentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_answer) AS answeredStudentCount, (SELECT first_answer_time FROM ranked_answer WHERE answer_rank = CEIL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_student) / 2.0) LIMIT 1) AS thresholdTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN active_student active ON active.student_id = answer.student_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id AND question.question_type = 'practical' WHERE answer.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND answer.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(answer.student_answer) <> '') AS dueCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN active_student active ON active.student_id = answer.student_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id AND question.question_type = 'practical' WHERE answer.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND answer.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(answer.student_answer) <> '' AND answer.score IS NOT NULL) AS gradedCount
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO biz_practical_grading_deadline (lesson_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, trigger_time, trigger_answered_count, trigger_student_count, deadline_days, original_deadline_time, current_deadline_time, initialization_source, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{triggerTime}, #{triggerAnsweredCount}, #{triggerStudentCount}, #{deadlineDays}, #{originalDeadlineTime}, #{currentDeadlineTime}, #{initializationSource}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_grading_deadline SET current_deadline_time = #{newDeadlineTime}, last_adjustment_type = #{adjustmentType}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deadline_id = #{deadlineId} AND current_deadline_time = #{oldDeadlineTime}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_practical_grading_deadline_audit (deadline_id, lesson_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, action_type, old_deadline_time, new_deadline_time, reason, operator_id, operator_name, operate_time) VALUES (#{deadline.deadlineId}, #{deadline.lessonId}, #{deadline.deptId}, #{deadline.entryYear}, #{deadline.classCode}, #{actionType}, #{oldDeadlineTime}, #{newDeadlineTime}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id AS auditId, action_type AS actionType, old_deadline_time AS oldDeadlineTime, new_deadline_time AS newDeadlineTime, reason, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, operate_time AS operateTime FROM biz_practical_grading_deadline_audit WHERE deadline_id = #{deadlineId} ORDER BY operate_time DESC, audit_id DESC

SELECT answer.lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson.dept_id AS deptId, student.entry_year AS entryYear, student.class_code AS classCode FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN biz_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_student student ON student.student_id = answer.student_id WHERE answer.answer_id = #{answerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT scope.scope_id AS scopeId, scope.lesson_id AS lessonId, scope.dept_id AS deptId, scope.entry_year AS entryYear, scope.class_code AS classCode FROM biz_lesson_class_scope scope WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_lesson_question lesson_question INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = lesson_question.question_id WHERE lesson_question.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND question.question_type = 'practical' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_practical_grading_deadline deadline WHERE deadline.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND deadline.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND deadline.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND deadline.class_code = scope.class_code ) AND scope.scope_id > #{afterScopeId} ORDER BY scope.scope_id LIMIT #{pageSize}
